subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Greed vs. Fear: The Emotional Cycle
description: One-minute skill: Greed vs. Fear: The Emotional Cycle.

hook.text: Ponzi schemes ride two emotions: greed on the way up and fear on the way down.

buildup.text: In the growth phase, greed overrides skepticism. Investors focus only on the gains.

discovery.text: When cracks appear, fear takes over — but it paralyzes rather than prompts action.

twist.text: Operators exploit the fear phase too, urging calm and discouraging withdrawals.

climax.text: By the time fear wins over loyalty, the money is already gone.

punchline.text: Greed gets you in. Fear keeps you there.

quiz.question: How do Ponzi operators exploit the fear phase?
options: They urge calm and discourage withdrawals
